## Description

A compound containing solids and one isolated vertex is exported in non-manifold mode (`write.step.nonmanifold`). The non-manifold writer iterates faces / edges and ignores the vertex entirely — vertex is silently dropped.

## Reproducer recipe

Compound = one cube + one isolated vertex at `(10,10,10)`. Set `write.step.nonmanifold` = true; write.

## Expected kernel behavior

non-manifold writer emits every top-level shape including isolated vertices and edges; do not filter by topology type.

## Notes

Provenance tier: writer-side — non-manifold export emits empty compound where vertex expected.
